classification.difficultyReason: Identify division by twenty-seven and perform the standard successive subtraction and bringing-down steps to find people per bus.

content.prompt: There are 27 buses available to transport 1107 fans to a football match. How many people will there be on each bus, if each bus contains the same number of people?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{array}{r}\hphantom{000}\hspace{0.9em}\underline{\hphantom{0}\hspace{0.9em}\hphantom{0}\hspace{0.9em}\hphantom{0}\mathllap{4}\hspace{0.9em}\hphantom{0}\mathllap{1}\hspace{0.9em}}\\
\hphantom{000}\mathllap{27\big)}\hspace{0.9em}\hphantom{0}\mathllap{1}\hspace{0.9em}\hphantom{0}\mathllap{1}\hspace{0.9em}\hphantom{0}\mathllap{0}\hspace{0.9em}\hphantom{0}\mathllap{7}\hspace{0.9em}\\
\hphantom{000}\mathllap{-}\hspace{0.9em}\underline{\hphantom{0}\mathllap{1}\hspace{0.9em}\hphantom{0}\mathllap{0}\hspace{0.9em}\hphantom{0}\mathllap{8}\hspace{0.9em}}\hphantom{0}\hspace{0.9em}\\
\hphantom{000}\hspace{0.9em}\hphantom{0}\hspace{0.9em}\hphantom{0}\hspace{0.9em}\hphantom{0}\mathllap{2}\hspace{0.9em}\hphantom{0}\mathllap{7}\hspace{0.9em}\\
\hphantom{000}\mathllap{-}\hspace{0.9em}\hphantom{0}\hspace{0.9em}\hphantom{0}\hspace{0.9em}\underline{\hphantom{0}\mathllap{2}\hspace{0.9em}\hphantom{0}\mathllap{7}\hspace{0.9em}}\\

Since $27\times4=108$, subtract 108 from 110, then bring down 7 to make 27. Since $27\times1=27$, the remainder is 0.

There will be 41 people on each bus.
